audience: on-call engineers and team leads who manage incidents and on-call schedules in All Quiet

useCases.title: Find out who is on call now or at a given time
useCases.text: The AI checks who is on call right now or at a point in time, and can filter by team or user. You get the names without opening the schedule.

useCases.title: Review recent incidents and get one as markdown
useCases.text: The AI lists incidents filtered by status, severity, team, user, search term or date range. It can return one incident as markdown to paste into a doc or chat.

useCases.title: Add up on-call hours for a team or person
useCases.text: The AI reads the on-call report for a time window, filtered by user, team or escalation tier. You get total on-call duration, for example for a monthly check.

useCases.title: Open an incident or change its severity or status
useCases.text: The AI creates a new incident, or changes the severity of an existing one and adds an action such as acknowledge, resolve, reopen or snooze. Creating an incident may page people.

useCases.title: Check or set an on-call override for a user
useCases.text: The AI lists the on-call overrides of a user, and can create a new override for a start and end time. This changes who is on call during that window.
